findings.title: Record the newly documented DFLASH path as a deferred qualification
findings.evidence: The same freshly retrieved cookbook names modal-labs/Kimi-K3-DFlash, default block size 8, Blackwell validation only, and no pipeline-parallel/DP-attention support.
findings.why_it_matters: The model plan currently covers DSpark only; explicitly deferring the additional documented path makes the remaining applicability work visible without implying a runnable audited profile.
findings.suggested_change: Add a short optional follow-up that requires exact drafter/config, target and build identity, same-build target-only control, natural acceptance and tool/image quality before use. Keep catalog/profiles unchanged.
findings.limit: This is a completeness suggestion, not a false-claim finding or a recommendation to run the unqualified draft.
findings.resolution: Read-only recheck confirms deferred DFLASH paragraph names exact discovery, Blackwell/no pipeline/no DP-attention scope, artifact/build/target qualification and matched target-only control before a candidate experiment.

findings.title: Record compressed attention state dtype independently from KV and indexer precision
findings.evidence: Cookbook distinguishes SGLANG_DSV4_COMPRESS_STATE_DTYPE for C4/C128 state pools from main KV dtype and model weights; generic example defaults FP32 and offers BF16.
findings.why_it_matters: These state pools can change capacity independently of the indexer-cache experiment, so an explicit fixed/logged effective value helps avoid attributing their memory gain to D02.
findings.suggested_change: Record/fix effective C4/C128 compressed-state dtype in initial qualification and D02. Treat any dtype change as separate and keep exact 0731 applicability unresolved until verified.
findings.limit: The cookbook BF16 example names the earlier Flash model; it must not be promoted as 0731 support from this review.
findings.resolution: Read-only recheck confirms D01 logs effective C4/C128 dtype/pool capacity, D02 holds state dtype fixed independently of MLA KV/indexer, and family BF16 example is explicitly not exact 0731 qualification.

limits: No model, benchmark harness or serving execution; source and plan review only.
verdict: No blocking issue found; both low-priority suggestions were incorporated by the author and independently rechecked.

checks.result: Reviewed author current/pinned receipts and independently retrieved immutable Kimi base/draft and DeepSeek base/inference configurations.

Independently confirmed SGLang Kimi simulated acceptance, DCP/pool distinctions; DeepSeek 4xGB300 v0.5.16 recipe, five proposals/six verification slots and bundled DSpark; exact NVIDIA derivative card explicitly says speculation was not exercised.
Compared all relevant atlas JSON profiles with plans. Kimi DCP/ReplaySSM confound is disclosed; generic vLLM NVFP4 block stays; DeepSeek equal-eight-GPU alternatives and parser probes remain gated.

Official BFCL pinned README contains chosen simple_python/parallel/multi_turn_base categories. RULER dependency pin, frozen LCB contract, separate MMMU-Pro settings, image ordering, retained responses and task-versus-transport distinctions are explicit.

Both plans respect 65536 total-token profiles, label 64K-plus-output infeasible and separate short shape runs from reasoning quality. DeepSeek longer publisher output budgets require separate cap qualification.
DeepSeek text 0731 is not treated as Flash Vision or V4.1; Kimi multimodal scoring is conditional on exact endpoint qualification.
Plans and review make no GPU, benchmark, model download, image-test, SLA or winning-engine claim.
